name: Unity Warning Suppressors
goalName: Reduce the amount of warnings and suggestions in the debug log without compromising the code's integrity
goal: Unity projects are bound to give warnings and suggestions in an IDE like Visual Studio. To keep a clear view of errors, the warnings and suggestions that can be justified need to be filtered out. By doing so, the debug log is kept clean and only contains warnings that require attention.
